description: Dear Friends and Neighbors,Thanksgiving is one of my most favorite holidays to celebrate. It allows us the opportunity to spend time with extended family and reflect on things for which we are grateful. Typically, I host a feast for around 25-30 family members. Although due to COVID-19, we made the difficult decision to cancel it this year and have limited our meal to immediate family. Nevertheless, the spirit of gratitude is still with us.
